doc.title: Billie Pierce, De De Pierce, Israel Gorman, Joseph "Kid Twat" Butler Interview, 1963-11-20

title: Non-musical family and starting trumpet
summary: His family did not play music; his father was a brick mason. He whistled, picked up a niece's trumpet and took lessons.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: What did your father do? Brickmation. Oh, I see. And you? Brickmation. Well, how did you get interested in music?

Well, I used to whistle a lot. You used to whistle a lot? I used to whistle a lot. And my niece of mine had a trumpet, and I picked it up on the heart, and we started playing, and I liked it. I went to lessons, and that's how I started it.
Well, did you have any inspiration before you started playing anybody you liked, especially, did you? Oh, no. It's like music. It's not. You didn't have any one special trumpet player you liked?
After I started playing a while. Before you started playing? Not in particular. I like music.
